title: An app cannot say who sees it: a fully gated app still shows in every launcher, and the only hide (hidden) is global
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.3.0** (hotcrm `main` `235106f`, local `pnpm dev`, throwaway apps in a scratch copy) while planning hotcrm#2417, which splits HotCRM into function apps: Sales, Service, and Marketing when enabled. The plan, with every reading, is [hotcrm#2417 comment 6814732293](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2417#issuecomment-6814732293), rows M7–M10. The maintainer approved it on 2026-11-12. Each function app lives in its own module package, which 18.3.0 allows (one app per `type: app` package, ADR-0019 D3).

| # | Observed on 18.3.0 | Wanted |
|---|---|---|
| M10 | Every entry of the Service app is gated away from a sales rep, yet the app **still** shows in the rep's launcher. Opening it says "Nothing in … is available to you yet". | An app can say who sees it: an app-level `visible` predicate (CEL over positions or permissions, like `AppSchema.landing`'s), **or** an app whose every entry the viewer cannot see drops out of their launcher and `/meta/app`. |
| M9 | `hidden: true` takes the app off "Your apps" for **everyone**, and its URL still opens. The platform's comment says it is navigation only. | Not a substitute: it is global, not per audience. Listed so the card does not ask for a permission gate. A URL that opens to an empty shell is acceptable. |
| M7/M8 | `/_console/` with two or more visible apps stops on the launcher home, and `isDefault: true` is global. | **Out of scope.** The maintainer set the per-position default app aside (see below). |

**Scope, per the maintainer (2026-11-12, verbatim):** 「平台现在没法按岗位决定谁看到哪个应用（需要）、默认进哪个应用（isDefault 是全局的）（暂时不考虑）」. Who sees which app is **needed**. The per-position default app is **set aside**.

**HotCRM's interim:** every position lands on the launcher home and picks an app. A rep sees a Service tile that opens to an empty shell. hotcrm#2417's acceptance line "a sales rep does not see the service app" waits on this card. Everything else in the split ships without it.

Filing gate **③ maintainer-directed**: the maintainer's 2026-11-12 ruling on hotcrm#2417 (Q2) names this as the platform half. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`).

**Grade: `priority:p1`** (suggested by the decision thread). It is the only platform gap in a 6.2 card the maintainer put first. Any multi-app product hits it: a user is shown apps they cannot use, with no per-role front door. **Size: S–M** (spec key or launcher rule, plus the console launcher and `/meta/app` filter).

**Dedupe:** I searched objectstack issues for `isDefault app`, `app launcher audience`, `per-position default app`, `app visible audience launcher` and `navigationContributions areas`. #28022 (closed) gave **one app** a landing per audience (`AppSchema.landing`). This card is the step above it: **which apps a person sees**. The other hits are page-level `isDefault` cards (#23015, #28979, #29592) and QA run logs.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat from hotcrm#2417's out-of-scope findings.</sub>
